title: Introduction and overview — Austin-Healey 3000 (1959-1967)
description: Introduction and overview of the Austin-Healey 3000 (1959-1967): What this car is, its place in automotive history, and why collectors care. The Austin-Healey 3000, the 'Big Healey,' was Britain's archetypal 1960s sports car with its 2.9-liter inline-six. It won its class at Sebring and rallied successfully across Europe. 42,926 were built; most were exported to America, where the car became a favorite of the sports-car boom. title: Racing and motorsport heritage — Austin-Healey 3000 (1959-1967)
description: Racing and motorsport heritage of the Austin-Healey 3000 (1959-1967): Competition history and homologation specials. The Austin-Healey 3000, the 'Big Healey,' was Britain's archetypal 1960s sports car with its 2.9-liter inline-six. It won its class at Sebring and rallied successfully across Europe. 42,926 were built; most were exported to America, where the car became a favorite of the sports-car boom.
